title: Swindon Borough Council: Simply Readable, an AI easy-read solution
summary: Swindon reports that Simply Readable creates Easy-Read documents in under 30 minutes at much lower cost, with input from residents with learning disabilities.
account: Swindon deployed Simply Readable to produce Easy-Read documents with AI, co-designed with residents with learning disabilities. The council reports document conversion in under 30 minutes and costs of 7–10 pence for material previously costing upwards of £600. The enormous ROI percentages are council claims and were not independently checked. The separate translation tool is mentioned, but its figures must not be attributed to Simply Readable.
purpose: Produce accessible Easy-Read documents more quickly and cheaply for residents who need them.
system: Simply Readable, built on Amazon Bedrock with council-selected foundation models
developer: Swindon Borough Council using Amazon Bedrock

ratings.reason: Lower conversion costs and shorter production time are efficiency gains, regardless of the size of the council’s claimed ROI.
The project supplies accessible Easy-Read material designed with residents, supporting improved information access. Actual comprehension or independence gains are not measured.

ai_role.statement: AI converts complex material into Easy-Read outputs through a council-built workflow. Residents influenced the design. The source reports time, cost, and access benefits, but does not establish measured comprehension or independence gains.

evidence.citation: Local Government Association, AI case-study bank. Council or project account published by LGA. Hosting and editorial curation do not establish independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Swindon Borough Council: Simply Readable, an AI easy-read solution

produced_by: The council co-designed the tool with residents with learning disabilities, including layout, language, spacing, and images.
The cloud-based workflow uses Amazon Bedrock and integrates with translation services.
must_hold: The source does not establish which conditions are necessary to reproduce the reported benefit.

headline: Swindon reports cheaper, faster Easy-Read documents

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The deployer's report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
